mode: verification (Thompson 1917 claim override) — not a new-model scout
claim: The forms of single cells and cell-like organisms (Plateau's oil globules; Lagena and other forams/protists) are surfaces of revolution from the minimal-surface catalogue: sphere, cylinder, unduloid, nodoid, catenoid.
seed_paper: Thompson, D.W. (1917) On Growth and Form, Ch. V 'The Forms of Cells', pp. 201-276, Figs. 61-67, 72-96 (Cambridge University Press)

pre_scouted_dataset.authors: Prazeres M, Uthicke S, Pandolfi JM (2015)

files_listed_by_api.description: pH and DIC data used to calculate carbonate system parameters used in the experiment

pre_scouted_dataset.file_download_status: Dryad API /files/<id>/download requires a bearer token; the public stash file_stream returned an HTML redirect. Only the dataset metadata record and file manifest were fetched (both SHA-256 pinned below).
pre_scouted_dataset.mismatch_reason: Species are the multilocular large benthic foraminifera Amphistegina lessonii and Marginopora vertebralis, not the monothalamic Lagena/Orbulina/Nodosaria figured by Thompson; variables are seawater pH/DIC carbonate-system parameters, buoyant weight, Ca/Mg-ATPase activity and micro-CT shell density under ocean acidification, with no test outlines, radius profiles or 2-D silhouettes. It cannot test whether a unilocular test outline is a Delaunay surface of revolution, so it is NOT used for the verdict.
pre_scouted_dataset.action_taken: Fell back to the registry-sanctioned path for every figure claim ('digitise Thompson's own 1917 plates from the pinned IA scan'; thompson_1917_dataset_audit.json row T1917-014 has digitize_1917_figures = true) and to a modern CC-BY specimen photograph of the same genus (Lagena).
